currentContext.business: Emmvee is primarily a solar module manufacturer that also produces solar cells using TOPCon and Mono PERC technologies. As of June 30, 2025 it had 7.80 GW of solar PV module and 2.94 GW of solar cell production capacity across four units in Karnataka, supplying IPPs, C&I customers and EPC providers domestically and abroad.

Discontinued: Polycrystalline modules (commercial production discontinued w.e.f. May 31, 2025)

currentContext.expansion: Emmvee is adding a 2.50 GW module line at Unit VI in Sulibele (operational expected Fiscal 2026) and a 6.00 GW integrated cell+module TOPCon facility at ITIR Phase-II, Devanahalli (operational expected first half of Fiscal 2028), taking module capacity to 16.30 GW and cell capacity to 8.94 GW. Both are funded via a Rs 33,060.00 million IREDA loan sanctioned May 22, 2025.

one-line thesis: Integrated TOPCon cell+module maker delivered its best-ever operational quarter — revenue ₹1,555 cr (+51% YoY), record module (970 MW) and cell (454 MW) production, EBITDA margin up to 35% and PAT +103% YoY on a sharp finance-cost drop. Thesis is now execution of the 6 GW integrated expansion (module Dec-26, cell Mar-27) and riding the ALMM List 2 DCR tailwind with a stated ₹2,400 cr FY27 EBITDA target.
financial scorecard (track qoq/yoy): > Sequential revenue dip is timing (LC establishment, monsoon-delayed pick-up on non-DCR), not lost demand. Finance-cost drop is the key PAT swing factor. FG inventory rose ₹74.25 cr (high production); RM inventory deliberately elevated on geopolitics.
guidance (critical — verify next quarter: FY27 EBITDA target: ~₹2,400 cr by close of FY27 (mgmt guiding on absolute EBITDA, not utilization %).
Margin / EBITDA-per-watt (stable outlook): non-DCR module ₹2–2.5/W, cell ₹6–6.5/W, DCR module ₹8.5–9/W. Guide on absolute EBITDA, not %.
Capacity utilization: module ~45% now, peak achievable ~65%; cell 83% now, peak 85–90% (already near). Base-case module util "similar levels" near-term.
Capex / commissioning: 6 GW integrated line — module Dec-2026, cell Mar-2027; post-expansion ~16.3 GW modules + 8.9 GW cells by end-FY27.
DCR demand to strengthen progressively through FY27 as grandfathered non-DCR projects complete.
order book & pipeline: Order book 9.9 GW (up from 9.4 GW end-FY26); Q1 inflow 1,484 MW. ~7+ GW to be executed over next 18 months. Demand across utility-scale, C&I and rooftop. C&I order inflows "already started" post-1-June ALMM, but supply/execution skews to H2 FY27. DCR now >50% of Q1 sales mix (modules + cells); order-book DCR share rising toward similar ~50% level. Sales are USD-denominated (natural hedge on silver-paste import cost).
segment / subsidiary detail: Modules: 970 MW produced (+53% YoY); effective util 45%; blended non-DCR realization ~15–16 US cents/W (+~₹1 on richer DCR).
Cells: 454 MW produced (+26% YoY); util 83% (up from 68% YoY) — highest ever; transitioning to G12R (raises effective capacity).
Merchant cell sales: highest-ever quarter, "meaningful" (not dominant) — lowered absolute COGS.
Installed base: 10.3 GW modules, 2.94 GW TOPCon cells.
growth verticals / optionality: 6 GW integrated TOPCon expansion (below) → 16.3 GW module / 8.9 GW cell by end-FY27.

Ingot–wafer backward integration: 9 GW in two phases — 5 GW FY29 + 4 GW FY30, commissioning mid-CY2028; funded largely by internal accruals; gated on ALMM List 3 clarity; intent = margin protection + upstream supply security.
Merchant cell sales scaling into tight domestic-cell market.
G12R cell transition lifting effective capacity.
6a. moat & competitive position (optiona: Integration + ALMM List 2 inclusion: >2 years of operating TOPCon cell capability; internal cell consumption (util 83%) plus ALMM certification gives DCR-market access that module-only importers lack — reflected in 35% EBITDA margin.

Bankability: management argues limited supply of bankable/credible modules for serious IPPs; positions Emmvee to choose customers "without letting go of the bottom line" — reasonable return at lower utilization preferred over volume at thin margin.
USD-denominated selling prices naturally offset USD-linked silver-paste input cost (partial FX hedge).
margins & cost dynamics: EBITDA margin 35.2% (Q1FY27) vs 32.84% (Q4FY26) — driven by richer DCR mix and higher domestic-cell content, not per-watt spread expansion (EBITDA/watt stable). Management guides on absolute EBITDA because % swings with input prices (silver paste). Pass-through handled via value engineering first, price pass-through only if margin can't be held. COGS fell ~18–19% QoQ on DCR mix + merchant cell sales.
capex / expansion (watch slippage): 6 GW integrated TOPCon: total project cost ~₹5,500 cr (hard cost ~₹4,600 cr); debt ~₹3,300 cr tied up at <8%; all major equipment ordered; ~60% of hard-cost orders placed. Module line by Dec-2026, cell line by Mar-2027. Utilization to scale progressively.
Ingot–wafer (9 GW): 5 GW FY29 + 4 GW FY30; commissioning mid-CY28; internal accruals; ALMM List 3-gated. WATCH: this is the main slippage/optionality item.
capital allocation: 6 GW expansion is ~60% debt-funded (₹3,300 cr at <8%) — but finance costs already falling sharply (₹11.1 cr vs ₹53.1 cr YoY), signalling prior deleveraging. Ingot-wafer to be funded "largely through internal accruals." No dividend/buyback discussed.
risks & watch-items: Silver paste import dependence + new DGFT silver-import licensing (managed via 3-month advance applications; approvals in 3–4 days so far — watch for tightening).
Non-DCR module market shrinking as C&I shifts to DCR cells; module-only economics compress — Emmvee mitigates via integration/DCR access.
Execution/commissioning slippage on 6 GW (Dec-26/Mar-27) and ingot-wafer timing tied to ALMM List 3 clarity.
Elevated RM + FG inventory (geopolitics) → inventory-value risk if prices fall (mgmt says orders LC/advance-covered, so limited).
management quality / tone: Confident, execution-focused; three-person bench (MD/CEO/CFO) answered granularly. Deliberately guides on absolute EBITDA (₹2,400 cr) rather than utilization/% to avoid input-price noise. Declined to disclose exact cell/module and DCR/non-DCR sales split (competitive). Candid on offtake-timing and inventory mechanics.
non-obvious takeaways: The PAT jump is disproportionately a finance-cost story (deleveraging), not just operating leverage — normalize for that.
DCR module economics (₹8.5–9/W) are ~3–4x non-DCR module (₹2–2.5/W); mix shift to DCR is the real margin engine, and ALMM List 2 structurally expands DCR demand.
Management is already looking past ALMM List 2 to ALMM List 3 (cell-level DCR) — the ingot-wafer plan is the hedge for that next regulatory step.
Merchant cell sales at record highs — a lever that distorts blended EBITDA/watt comparisons.
qoq change log (fill each quarter): Q1 FY27 (this): Revenue ₹1,555 cr (+51% YoY, ~−11% QoQ), EBITDA ₹548 cr @35.2%, PAT ₹380 cr (+103%); order book 9.9 GW; module 970 MW / cell 454 MW record; DCR >50% of mix; FY27 EBITDA target ₹2,400 cr; 6 GW expansion module Dec-26 / cell Mar-27 (₹5,500 cr, ₹3,300 cr debt <8%); ingot-wafer 9 GW (5 FY29 + 4 FY30, mid-CY28).
Q2 FY27 → check: DCR mix trend, module utilization toward 65%, 6 GW commissioning progress vs Dec-26, EBITDA run-rate vs ₹2,400 cr FY27, silver-import approval cadence.

themes.title: Solar PV cell-to-module manufacturing
themes.need: Solar module/cell manufacturers ride capacity ramp, ALMM/DCR protection and an order-book build-out - a manufacturing thesis distinct from firm-power/FDRE tender economics or merchant storage arbitrage. Q1FY27 quantified the DCR arbitrage: EMMVEE grew revenue 51% to INR 1,555cr with EBITDA margin up to 35.2% and PAT +103% on a 9.9 GW order book, with DCR modules earning INR 8.5-9/W of EBITDA against INR 2-2.5/W for non-DCR - a 3-4x per-watt gap that structurally separates integrated cell makers from module assemblers. The offset is order timing: SWSOLAR booked a record INR 13,000cr unexecuted order value on a landmark USD 560m Egypt win (1,000 MW solar + 600 MWh BESS) yet revenue still fell 10% YoY, and flagged that industry orders concluded only ~INR 6,400cr against the >INR 20,000cr expected, deferred by DCR/module-price uncertainty.
themes.driver: DCR cell/module capacity commissioning and the ALMM List-2 per-watt spread; domestic ordering restarting after two slow quarters (SWSOLAR); order-book conversion.
